goal: SkillSelectPanel 中的 CPR（心肺复苏）技能选择卡片

subject.concept: 心肺复苏示意图，双手按压胸腔的抽象医学图示
subject.symbolism: 生命救援、黄金四分钟、基础急救技能，CPR 是急救培训的核心

style.rendering: 介于扁平和立体之间，有轻微深度感的概念艺术
style.image_tone: 深蓝黑为主，蓝色光线点缀，医学示意风格

layout.image_area: 上半部分约 70% 为技能示意图
layout.text_area: 下半部分约 30% 预留给文字标题（不渲染文字）
layout.composition: 居中构图，医学图示风格

prompt: A concept art illustration card showing CPR (cardiopulmonary resuscitation) technique for VR medical training, depicting a stylized view of two hands pressing on a chest area with pressure arrows indicating the compression motion, abstract medical diagram style, dark blue-black atmosphere with base colors #1A1A2E and #0D0D1A, blue accent lighting #00B4D8 highlighting the hand positions and pressure points, subtle heartbeat pulse line or ECG waveform as decorative element, the rendering is between flat and dimensional with slight depth, cold professional medical lighting, the upper 70% shows the CPR illustration while the lower 30% is a darker gradient area, 512x384 resolution, centered composition, no text, no UI overlays, no realistic gore or blood, suitable as a skill selection card for VR training
